summary.text: Brian Ashe is a Democratic state representative from Longmeadow who has represented the 2nd Hampden District since 2009 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served on the Longmeadow Select Board from 2001 to 2008 and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ashe attended Cathedral High School and earned a bachelor's degree in business management and a master's degree in criminal justice from Westfield State College.
He served on the Longmeadow Select Board from 2001 to 2008, chairing it in 2003 and 2006, and on the Metropolitan Planning Organization from 2004 to 2007.
Ballotpedia also lists him as a member of the Pioneer Valley Transit Authority Advisory Board.
Ashe has served in the Massachusetts House since 2009.

His current committee assignments are vice chair of the House Committee on Bills in the Third Reading, the House Committee on Steering, Policy and Scheduling, and the Joint Committees on Community Development and Small Businesses and on Tourism, Arts and Cultural Development.
